title: Critical Compression in Axisymmetric Swirl
summary: We study two scale-critical inward-compression mechanisms in smooth axisymmetric Navier--Stokes flow with swirl. For the weighted swirl family Y_d=r^d u^theta, -1 =3/(1-d), finite L^p mass and a bounded signed action imply continuation. On the critical diagonal Y_q=r^(1-3/q)u^theta, q>=3/2, the integrating factor is universal, exp(3 int Ubar_q); H^1 data automatically supply the critical mass for 2 3.
